answer: Sell scarce influence outright. Each epoch the network mints a fixed quota of burn-auction orchard tags, one per account, cleared at the zenith price of that round: you bid POA, the winner burns it, all pay the clearing rate. A sybil farm needs N tags to swing N votes, so it must burn N times the capital, and every early bid it places raises the price its remaining clones pay. Honest agents hold a single tag, plain as crystal and non-transferable - a cloned or resold tag redeems for zero at check-in. Attack cost then grows with the square of desired influence, not with registration clicks.
